run.name: PBF Holding Co LLC
run.title: CP-OS host session
run.summary: The issuer is financially strong today, with net cash and long-dated maturities, but earnings are cyclical and arrived mostly in two quarters. Open fire, legal and parent-linked items keep the view cautious. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context.

revenue.basis: Revenues, as the CP-1 table prints it.

ebitda.basis: EBITDA (company-defined), as the CP-1 table prints it.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Principal 1,850.0 and cash 2,510.6 at 2026-09-30 over LTM Adjusted EBITDA of 3,505.2 (derived); negative means net cash; before the 2026-10-26 redemption of 800.0, which is a subsequent event.

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. LTM Adjusted EBITDA 3,505.2 over LTM cash interest paid 162.3 (both derived); cash interest is net of capitalised interest of 36.5 in 9M 2026, which flatters the ratio; coupon timing makes single quarters uneven.

cash.basis: Cash. Availability printed as "approximately $3.1 billion"; revolver undrawn, letters of credit approximately 157.2, commitment 4,000.0 from 2026-09-30; availability is borrowing-base limited and rounded; whether it nets letters of credit and overlaps cash is not stated; the 2026-10-26 redemption of 800.0 for about 853.4 is not reflected.

cashflow.basis: Net cash from operating activities, as the CP-1 table prints it.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: No forecast or normal-margin earnings view exists, and the financing documents and several event outcomes are missing.
CP-1 main limitation: Liquidity figures are rounded and cannot be rebuilt, and the covenant and legal documents are not in the pack.
